thayer.title: A Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (Thayer)
thayer.author: C. L. W. Grimm & C. G. Wilke, tr./rev./enl. Joseph Henry Thayer (1889)

scheme.honesty: page-exact; entries NOT segmented
scheme.note: OCR'd from the Internet Archive scan (greekenglishlexi00grimuoft, 760pp) with tesseract grc+eng at 300dpi on 2026-09-06, because no machine-readable Thayer's exists: that scan's own text layer contains ZERO Greek codepoints. This pass recovered 552,594. 744 pages carry text; the other 16 were checked individually and are the two cloth covers plus 14 blank leaves. 4,534 headwords detected heuristically and flagged as such -- Thayer's has ~5,600 entries and OCR cannot delimit them reliably, so no entry claim is made. Text is OCR output: it has not been proofread against the page, and Greek diacritics are where OCR errs most.
